nodes.name: Store Feedback
nodes.notes: Create the 'returnshield_feedback' Data Table once in the n8n UI before first use. If it's missing, this fails gracefully and the response still confirms what was submitted - it just won't be queryable later until the table exists.

parameters.content:
## ReturnShield AI - Record Feedback (companion workflow)

Implements spec sections 16 (human-in-the-loop) and 19 (feedback loop / closed-loop learning).

POST { "run_id", "target", "outcome", "note?", "recorded_by?" }.
outcome is one of: accepted, rejected, implemented, resolved, ineffective, incorrect, approved, denied.

Use approved/denied to record a human sign-off on a recommendation the main workflow flagged requires_human_approval = true, BEFORE anyone acts on it. Use implemented/resolved/ineffective after the fact to close the loop on whether it worked.

Create a Data Table named 'returnshield_feedback' once (Data tables tab) with columns: run_id, target, outcome, note, recorded_by, recorded_at (all text) before first use.
